hook.text: How do you turn a circle into a spring?

youtube.title: From a circle to a helix to a spiral 🌀 #shorts
youtube.description:
A circle turns in a flat plane. Let it climb while it turns and you get a helix, the shape of a spring and of DNA. Let it widen as well and it becomes a cone spiral.

#math #learn #shorts

texts.text: Widen while climbing: a cone spiral

hook.text: What does a formula of x and y look like?

youtube.title: Formulas that make landscapes ⛰️ #shorts
youtube.description:
A formula of two variables gives a height for every point: a landscape. sin x · cos y makes hills, x² − y² a saddle, and a sine of the distance a ripple.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: height = sin x · cos y: hills and valleys
A ripple: sin of the distance

hook.text: Can you guess the shape from the formula?

youtube.title: Bowl, bell, egg box: guess the formula 🥣 #shorts
youtube.description:
x² + y² curves up in every direction: a bowl. e^(−r²) is the bell curve spun around. cos x + cos y repeats in both directions like an egg box.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: e^(−r²): a bell, the 3D bell curve
cos x + cos y: an egg box

hook.text: Can a formula tie a knot?

youtube.title: Formulas that tie knots 🪢 #shorts
youtube.description:
Go round a ring p times while winding through it q times and the curve ties a torus knot. 2 and 3 give the trefoil, the simplest real knot.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: Round a ring: a simple loop
2 turns round, 3 through: a trefoil knot

youtube.title: Lissajous curves in 3D 🧶 #shorts
youtube.description:
Give x, y and z sine waves with different frequencies. 1 and 2 make a figure eight; add a third and it lifts into 3D; 3 : 4 : 5 makes a tangle that still closes perfectly.

#math #learn #shorts
